messages:
marta: FYI customer-reported spike of 503s starting 2025-11-02T09:12Z after a model swap to quant-v2. Multiple tenants affected (acme, atlas).

sam: Oof. Any error correlates in infer-runner logs?

alex: saw repeated 'segfault (signal 11) at 0x7f...' from inferd worker and 'GPU reset detected' lines. Pasting kdmesg snippet:
```
[12345.678901] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: RmInitAdapter failed! (0x12f2)
[12345.678912] inferd[2345]: segfault at 7f... ip 00007f... libattention.so(+0x12a8)
```

jia: nvml also shows process crashed with 'CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH_OUT_OF_RESOURCES' right before segfault.

support-queue: Customer ACME reported backend 503s and request timeouts in the last 8m. Ticket #12345 opened and notifying account team.

alex: Repro on staging: qps ~200, seq len 2048 triggers same segfault shortly after model load with quantization flags. Quick repro steps:
1) deploy model quant-v2
2) warm pools with batch=16
3) send payloads with long contexts (~2k tokens)
Result: worker OOM -> segfault -> container restart -> 503s at gateway.

sam: Can we route ACME to a fallback model until we have a fix? eng-runtime can add a temporary route.

eng-runtime: Re-assigning. @alex please attach full inferd logs, container exit codes, and any core dumps. Also include the exact container image SHA.

alex: attaching short stacktrace we pulled from core: 
```
#0 0x7fabc123 in attention::forward(attn_params*)
#1 0x7fabc987 in model::invoke
#2 0x55f0011 in main
```
Container exit: SIGSEGV(11) pid=2345 code=0x1
Image: redwood/quant-runtime:2025-11-02-sha256:deadbeef

marta: Paging @eng-oncall per SLA (customer-impact). @sam please initiate fallback routing and pin ACME's deployment to the previous model v1.

sam: Done. Routed ACME -> redwood/llm-small-v1 and pinned model version. Error rate for ACME dropped to baseline within 90s. :white_check_mark:

eng-ml: Hypothesis: quant-v2 kernel selection is picking a fused attention kernel that misbehaves on certain GPU firmware/driver combos. Need host list and driver/CUDA versions. Also request nvcc+cuDNN checks.

alex: Failing hosts observed: gpu-03, gpu-07, gpu-11 (us-west2). Driver 525.119, CUDA 12.1 on all three. Non-failing host gpu-02 has driver 525.105.

eng-infra: Noted. Scheduling a repro job pinned to gpu-03. We'll repro in an isolated namespace and capture full dmesg/nvml dumps.

support-queue: Status update posted to customers; internal ticket updated with mitigation steps and ETA for next update.

eng-runtime: Temporary mitigation applied across affected fleet: disable auto-swap to quant-v2, increase worker restart backoff, and enable stricter OOM thresholds to avoid crashing on first allocation.

jia: Adding debug flag QUANT_DEBUG=1 to the debug deploy and enabling core dumps to /var/crash. Collecting nvcrash and minidumps.

sam: Next steps for eng teams:
- eng-ml: run sanitizer builds and reproduce locally with same driver stack
- eng-runtime: gather core + nvcrash + kube exit hooks for failing containers
- eng-infra: verify if firmware update/amend rollback on failing hosts can mitigate

marta: If we confirm kernel regression in fused attention kernels, decide between: rollback quant-v2, push kernel fix, or blacklist fused kernels for affected drivers. Keep this thread updated.

support-queue: ACME confirmed recovered; closing customer ticket but leaving incident open for internal follow-up. Will reopen if errors reoccur.

eng-ml: Also adding long-term test: fuzz long-context quantized runs in CI against driver set 525.119 to catch regressions.

marta: Thanks team. If error rate rises again, we'll escalate to a Sev. For now mitigation successful and customers routed.
